fact: The World Bank's WDI lists 2022 as the latest population census for Algeria.
The World Bank's WDI lists the Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey 2018-2019 as the latest demographic, education or health household survey for Algeria.
The World Bank's WDI lists the Integrated household survey, 2011, as the source of the most recent income and expenditure data for Algeria.
The World Bank's SPI lists population censuses for Algeria in 1998, 2008 and 2022 within its scoring window; the latest year is used.
